question.text: A block of mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi></math> is moving along <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math>-axis under the action of force <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>F</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math>. The work done by the force in moving the block from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> will be _______ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Work done is W=∫Fdx

It is given that

F=5x N

So, work done is 

W=∫245xdx=5x2224⇒W=5(16-4)2=30 J
